cards.note: So that, for a purpose: Saya bangun awal supaya saya tidak lambat.
Although, even though. Learn it as a whole word. Root in the ledger: walau. Walaupun saya penat, saya suka mendaki.

cards.gloss_en: if (formal or written; kalau is everyday)
cards.note: If. Formal or written; everyday speech says «kalau» (Ch7): Kalau hujan, kita makan di kafe.

cards.gloss_en: when (formal or written; bila is everyday)
cards.note: When. Formal or written; everyday speech says «bila» (Ch4).
While doing something else: Dia makan sambil membaca surat khabar.
However. Written only; everyday speech says «tapi» (Ch5).
Therefore. Formal; everyday speech says «jadi» (below). A fixed phrase: oleh (Ch9) + itu.
akhir + -nya: finally, at last. Akhirnya kita makan di kafe.
First, at first. Learn it as a whole word (repeated words come in Stage 3). Root in the ledger: mula (Ch4).

cards.gloss_en: next, after that (formal; lepas tu is everyday)
cards.note: Next, after that. Formal; everyday speech says «lepas tu» (spoken). Learn it as a whole word. Root in the ledger: terus (Ch7).
During, when. Learn it as a whole word. Root in the ledger: masa (Ch4). Semasa mendaki, kita minum air.
Since: Sejak bulan lepas saya suka mendaki.
tuju + -an: purpose. Learn it as a whole word.
pilih (Ch6) + -an: a choice. Ada dua pilihan.
Learn it as a whole word: ke- … -an words come in Stage 3. Root in the ledger: putus. Decision, or result.
Learn it as a whole word: per- … -an words come in Stage 3. Root in the ledger: ubah. Perubahan rancangan = a change of plan.
So, therefore (everyday). The partner of the formal oleh itu: Jadi, boleh kita tangguhkan ke hari Ahad?

cards.gloss_en: To put off; to pause for a while
cards.note: To put off, to postpone. In a full sentence, tangguh + -kan (below): Boleh kita tangguhkan ke hari Ahad?
A promise; to promise. You know it from temu janji (Ch13). Janji!

cards.gloss_ja: 取り消す・中止になる
cards.note: To cancel; cancelled. Mendaki batal.
tangguh + -kan (Ch14): to postpone, to put something off. Boleh kita tangguhkan ke hari Ahad?

cards.gloss_ja: 取り消す、キャンセルする
cards.note: batal + -kan (Ch14): to cancel something. Kita batalkan rancangan mendaki.

frames.example: Kalau hujan, kita makan di kafe.
frames.meaning_en: If it rains, we'll eat at the cafe.
frames.meaning_ja: 雨が降ったら、カフェで食べましょう。

frames.example: Saya tidak datang kerana saya bekerja.
frames.meaning_en: I'm not coming because I'm working.
frames.meaning_ja: 仕事があるので、行きません。

frames.frame: Saya bangun awal supaya saya tidak ___.
frames.example: Saya bangun awal supaya saya tidak lambat.
frames.meaning_en: I get up early so that I won't be late.
frames.meaning_ja: 遅れないように、早く起きます。

frames.example: Walaupun hujan, saya mahu berjalan kaki.
frames.meaning_en: Even though it's raining, I want to walk.
frames.meaning_ja: 雨でも、歩いて行きたいです。

frames.example: Dia makan sambil membaca surat khabar.
frames.meaning_en: He eats while reading the newspaper.
frames.meaning_ja: 彼は新聞を読みながら食べます。

frames.frame: Mula-mula kita ___, kemudian kita ___, akhirnya kita ___.
frames.example: Mula-mula kita makan, kemudian kita berjalan kaki, akhirnya kita balik.
frames.meaning_en: First we eat, then we walk, finally we go home.
frames.meaning_ja: まず食べて、それから歩いて、最後に帰ります。

scenario.title_en: Rain, work and a changed plan

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Cik Mei Ling, hujung minggu ini kita masih mahu mendaki?
lines.en: Mei Ling, do we still want to go hiking this weekend?

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Masih. Tetapi cuaca mendung. Kalau hujan pada hari Sabtu, kita tidak boleh mendaki.
lines.en: Yes. But the weather is cloudy. If it rains on Saturday, we can't hike.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Kalau hujan, kita makan di kafe. Kalau tidak hujan, kita mendaki.
lines.en: If it rains, we'll eat at the cafe. If it doesn't rain, we'll hike.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Bagus! Tetapi saya tidak boleh datang pada hari Sabtu kerana saya bekerja.
lines.en: Great! But I can't come on Saturday because I'm working.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Ada dua pilihan: kita tangguhkan ke hari Ahad atau ke hari Sabtu depan.
lines.en: There are two choices: we put it off until Sunday or until next Saturday.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Hari Ahad lebih baik. Hari Ahad saya cuti. Janji!
lines.en: Sunday is better. I'm off on Sunday. I promise!

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Ada perubahan rancangan, tetapi tujuan kita sama: berehat dan berjalan.
lines.en: The plan has changed, but our purpose is the same: to rest and to walk.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Baik. Ini rancangan kita. Mula-mula kita berjumpa di stesen pukul tujuh. Kemudian kita mendaki. Akhirnya kita makan di kafe.
lines.en: Okay. This is our plan. First we meet at the station at seven. Then we hike. Finally we eat at the cafe.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Saya akan datang awal supaya kita tidak lambat.
lines.en: I'll come early so that we're not late.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Bagus. Walaupun saya penat, saya suka mendaki. Kita boleh bercakap sambil berjalan.
lines.en: Good. Even though I'm tired, I like hiking. We can talk while walking.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Kalau hujan lagi pada hari Ahad, bagaimana?
lines.en: What if it rains again on Sunday?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Kita batalkan rancangan mendaki, tetapi kita masih makan di kafe. Itu keputusan kita.
lines.en: The hike is off, but we still eat at the cafe. That's our decision.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Baik. Saya sudah tulis mesej untuk kawan kita. Jika hujan, kita tangguhkan. Apabila cuaca cerah, kita mendaki.
lines.en: Fine. I've written a message for our friends. If it rains, we put it off. When the weather is clear, we hike.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Oh, itu bahasa mesej. Kalau kita bercakap, kita guna kalau dan bila, ya?
lines.en: Oh, that's message language. When we speak, we use kalau and bila, right?
